The documents don't say when Mark Webber won a Grand Prix for the first time. They only show his finishes in the 2005 Spanish GP (6th, Williams), the 2006 Spanish GP (9th, Williams), and the 2000-2025 races listed. So this answer relies on my own knowledge, not the documents.

From that knowledge, Webber's first win was the 2009 German Grand Prix, driving for Red Bull. The 2009 constructors' championship was won by Brawn GP.

ANSWER: Brawn GP
